What is a Ductless Mini Split System & How Does It Work?
Thanks to its versatile design, a ductless air conditioner is a great option for homes without existing ductwork; you can cool multiple rooms without a major remodeling project.

A ductless mini-split, just like a regular air conditioner, has an outside condenser. However, this condenser unit connects to multiple indoor air handling units throughout your home. This allows for various areas of your home to have different temperature settings to accommodate the demands of each household member.

What Are the Benefits of A Mini-Split System?
A ductless air conditioner in San Antonio has a range of benefits, making them a great choice for homeowners.
Some of the benefits you can expect to enjoy:

items: No air leaks: Ductwork in a home can leak air and waste energy. It’s also nearly impossible to eliminate all gaps around a window unit or portable air conditioner. A ductless mini-split has no ductwork or awkward window installation to leak in the first place, so you can rest easy knowing that your hard earned money isn’t literally blowing away.

Zone cooling: With a standard air conditioner, setting up zones can be difficult; this means that you generally have to cool your entire home regardless of need. A ductless mini-split, on the other hand, allows you to only cool the rooms in use allowing for custom indoor climate solutions.

Small size: Many smaller or older homes just don’t have the room for the ductwork required by central air conditioning. A ductless mini-split is so compact, it can fit just about anywhere. Additionally, you won’t have to face complicated installations when you rely on our experts for help.

Energy savings: Aside from their small size, a ductless air conditioner also provide customers with energy savings. Instead of running the entire HVAC unit, which can waste energy, you can turn on individual zones in your home for more efficient cooling.
